answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; traversing the ridge of information-theoretic security, our scheme embeds a verifiable randomness beacon in a grove of sequential delay functions, yielding a comet of cryptographic finality that immunizes against Byzantine faults, thereby guaranteeing unforgeability of reputation credentials and preventing malicious agents from spawning spurious identities.
